batch: Exodus Block 3 - The Tabernacle Instructions (Ex 25:1-31:18). THIN block (mostly construction detail); passages cast by section, surfacing only genuine inner-being spans, not forcing meaning on measurements.

units.characteristics: the willing heart of the offering; the ark, table, lampstand (construction)
units.gist: LAW/THIN - the LORD tells Moses to take a contribution from everyone whose HEART (lev 25:2) MOVES HIM / is WILLING (nadab 25:2) - the freewill offering; then the ark, mercy seat, table, and lampstand specified (mostly construction: pure gold, dimensions, the pattern shown on the mountain). Genuine inner-being = the WILLING HEART that gives; rest is making-detail.

units.characteristics: the skilled design; the service of the tent (mostly construction)
units.gist: LAW/THIN - the tabernacle curtains, frames, the veil, the bronze altar, the court. Almost entirely construction. Genuine spans sparse: the cherubim SKILFULLY WORKED / DEVISED (chashav 26:1,31 - the craftsman's design), 'according to the PLAN/manner (mishpat 26:30) shown you', the SERVICE (avodah 27:19,21) of the tent. Capture the design/service spans; do not force meaning on dimensions.

units.characteristics: garments for glory and beauty; the wise-hearted; the breastpiece of judgment on the heart; bearing the guilt
units.gist: LAW/GEM(thin-rich) - the priestly garments 'for GLORY (kavod 28:2) and beauty'; made by the WISE-HEARTED (chakam-lev) whom God FILLED with the spirit of WISDOM (chokmah/chashav 28:3); the breastpiece of JUDGMENT (mishpat 28:15,30) with the Urim and Thummim, Aaron bearing the names of Israel on his HEART (lev 28:29,30) before the LORD; the golden plate 'Holy to the LORD', Aaron bearing the GUILT/iniquity (avon 28:38) of the holy things that they may be ACCEPTED (ratson 28:38); consecration (qadash 28:41). The mediator's garments carry glory, judgment, and guilt-bearing.

units.characteristics: the ordination; atonement, the soothing aroma; God dwells and is known
units.gist: LAW/THIN-RICH - the seven-day ordination of the priests: the SIN OFFERING (chattath 29:14,36), the ram of ordination, blood on ear/thumb/toe, the SOOTHING AROMA (nichoach 29:18,25,41), ATONEMENT (kaphar/kippurim 29:33,36,37) for the altar, CONSECRATION (qadash 29:33,37,44). Climax = 'I will DWELL among the people of Israel and be their God, and they shall KNOW that I am the LORD their God who brought them out' (29:45-46), the GLORY (kavod 29:43) sanctifying the tent. Much ritual mechanics; capture atonement/aroma/dwelling-and-known.

units.characteristics: the ransom for a life; each counted, rich and poor alike; the holy anointing
units.gist: LAW/THIN-RICH - the incense altar; then the census - each gives a RANSOM for his LIFE (nephesh 30:12), atonement money, the RICH (ashir 30:15) not more and the poor not less (each life equal before God), for ATONEMENT (kaphar 30:15,16); the bronze laver; the holy anointing oil and incense (holy, not to be imitated). Genuine gem = the ransom for the nephesh, each life counted equally; rest is compounding-detail.

units.characteristics: the Spirit-filled craftsman; wisdom, understanding, knowledge for making; the sabbath sign of sanctification
units.gist: LAW/GEM - Bezalel CALLED (qara 31:2) and FILLED with the SPIRIT of God, with WISDOM (chokmah), UNDERSTANDING (tevunah 31:3), KNOWLEDGE (daath 31:3), and all craftsmanship to DEVISE (chashav 31:4) designs; and the WISE-HEARTED (chakam-lev 31:6) given ability. Then the SABBATH a SIGN forever - 'that you may KNOW that I am the LORD who SANCTIFIES (qadash 31:13) you', a COVENANT (berit 31:16) sign, God RESTED and was REFRESHED (naphash 31:17); the two tablets written by God's finger (31:18). The interior gifted for making; the sabbath the sign of the sanctifying God.
